title: Expose authenticated processing health

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Processing health API tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_processing_health_api.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/contracts/photo-processing-api.md#processing-health-and-slo RED: no authenticated inventory boundary assembles the exact queue, nullable controlled SLO and independent storage projection; GREEN: operator/developer cases return the exact schema across no-interval, half-open populated and empty interval inputs plus normal/low/unavailable store combinations, while photographer/auth/SPA/query/owner failures map exactly; decisive comparison: response fields/statuses reconcile to each provider, the empty interval has zero counts and null ratio/verdict, protected markers remain absent and no handler write occurs; artifact: isolated API/provider matrix and redacted marker scan.
purpose: Assemble the exact operator/developer processing-health API from owner-backed queue, SLO and independent capacity projections.
success_outcome: Authorized operator/developer requests receive the exact current queue, optional controlled SLO and separate PostgreSQL/MinIO results; every auth, validation, owner-read failure and redaction rule is preserved.
anti_goals: Do not let handlers query/write processing state, calculate another SLO, expose infrastructure paths/content or add a custom error envelope.
Do not add photographer health access, WebSocket/SSE, materialized metrics, another observability store or probe history.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
Direct transport or inventory writes to processing-owned rows
Exposure of credentials, auth state, paths, object keys, embeddings, model assets or commercial media
stop_conditions: Inventory cannot assemble the outcome through accepted projections and existing staff principal.
The endpoint would require broader roles, public infrastructure, another monitoring service or production data.

constraints: GET /api/inventory/processing-health requires active operator/developer and exact paired interval rules.
Use disposable staff/SPA/processing/storage fixtures with known initial state, safe repeat and owner-bounded cleanup.
A single capacity-probe failure remains a successful current observation when owner state read succeeds.
invariants: Inventory owns authorization/assembly; processing and infrastructure observations keep their own truth.
Without both interval bounds ingest_to_searchable is null; invalid/partial/equal/reversed intervals are 422.
A valid empty half-open interval returns zero counts and null success_ratio/meets_95_percent.
One store's unavailable status never replaces the other result, and no protected value leaves the application boundary.
verification_targets: Exact valid/401/403/404/422/5xx matrix covers roles, half-open/empty interval rules, queue/SLO fields and independent capacity states.
Owner-boundary and redaction tracing proves no handler business orchestration, foreign write or protected marker exposure.
